usedFor: Feature flag changes in LaunchDarkly, like “Flag Variations Updated”, feed a prompt to “Generate Content” in Google AI Studio (Gemini).

bestTemplate.name: “Flag Variations Updated” in LaunchDarkly, then “Generate Content” in Google AI Studio (Gemini)
bestTemplate.why: A flag variation change feeds the prompt, and the action turns it into written content about the change.

watchOut: “Generate Content” works from the prompt, so map “Flag Variations Updated” details into it or the text skips the flag.
